please contact the parish office. synodal evaluation assemble 2027: why are we holding an assembly?

pope leo has asked every diocese to hold a pastoral assembly during the first half of 2027. each diocese is invited to review how it has progressed in becoming a more synodal church – a church in which all the baptised share responsibility for its life and mission.
the diocese of kerry will hold its evaluation assembly on

sat 10th april 2027. the assembly will review our experience since the publication of the synod’s final document in 2025. it will recognise where synodal ways of working are already developing, identify what may be hindering progress, and agree the next steps needed to strengthen the mission of the diocese.
